youtube.description:
Flat maps stretch everything near the poles. Watch each shape slide to its real size 🌍 Did Texas vs Chile get you?
Comment your score out of 4 👇

Follow for a new quiz every day! 🧠

#map #geography #truesize #whichisbigger #quiz #shorts

Data: total area in km² – Iceland 103,000; Cuba 109,884; California 423,970; Japan 377,915; Texas 695,662; Chile 756,102; Cambodia 181,035; Florida 170,312 (countries: CIA World Factbook; US states: US Census Bureau).
Outlines: Natural Earth (public domain). The shapes are moved on the globe and re-projected (Mercator) – no resizing by hand.
Music: original.
